batches.notes: Cross-cuisine weeknight dinners, 15-45 minutes. All recipes written in RecDex voice, sourced from well-established preparations published by NYT Cooking and Bon Appétit. Ingredients and steps verified against canonical versions.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken Thighs with Potatoes
recipes.sourceNote: Based on Clark's sheet pan chicken philosophy — bone-in thighs, one pan, high heat. The arugula-and-lemon finish is a common NYT weeknight move.

recipes.title: Miso-Glazed Salmon
recipes.sourceNote: Rooted in Nobu's iconic miso-marinated black cod technique, widely adapted for home salmon by both NYT and BA. The white miso, mirin, sake ratio is the established standard.

recipes.title: Caramelized Shallot Pasta
recipes.sourceNote: Inspired by Heuck's viral caramelized shallot pasta and the broader NYT tradition of simple, ingredient-forward pasta recipes. The slow-cooked shallot technique is the foundation.

recipes.title: Orecchiette with Sausage and Broccoli Rabe
recipes.sourceNote: A canonical Italian-American pasta found across both NYT and BA. The blanch-in-pasta-water technique is universal. Ratios follow the standard 1:1:1 (lb pasta, lb sausage, lb broccoli rabe).

recipes.title: Black Pepper Tofu
recipes.sourceNote: Based on Ottolenghi's iconic recipe from Plenty. The aggressive black pepper, butter-shallot base, and kecap manis are signature elements. Widely adapted by NYT and food publications.

recipes.title: Crispy Ginger Chicken Thighs
recipes.sourceNote: Inspired by BA's approach to pan-crisped boneless thighs with Asian-style glazes. The sear-then-glaze technique is a weeknight standard from the test kitchen.

recipes.title: White Beans with Spinach and Lemon
recipes.sourceNote: Inspired by NYT's pantry-forward weeknight cooking, particularly Slagle's bean-centric quick meals. The smash-a-few-beans technique for thickening is a widely published tip.

recipes.title: Soy-Glazed Pork Chops
recipes.sourceNote: Inspired by BA's quick-glaze pork chop technique and the test kitchen's cast-iron basting approach. The soy-brown sugar-sambal combination is a BA weeknight staple.

recipes.title: Harissa Lamb Chops
recipes.sourceNote: Inspired by Baraghani's harissa-forward cooking style and the broader BA/NYT trend of North African flavors in quick weeknight dinners. The yogurt-mint condiment is standard.

recipes.title: Coconut-Turmeric Chicken
recipes.sourceNote: Inspired by the broader NYT and BA tradition of quick coconut-milk curries. The sear-then-simmer approach and fish sauce + lime finish are standard Southeast Asian technique.
